title: anee.io Review: What Is anee.io, What Does It Do Well, and Who Is It For?
metaTitle: anee.io Review: Our Own Honest Look at the Farm App
metaDescription: Our own anee.io review, by the anee.io team: what the farm app does, its standout tools, plans from free to PHP 600 a month, and who it suits best.
excerpt: This anee.io review is our own overview, written by the anee.io team, not an independent test. In short, anee.io is a farm app built for Filipino farmers to plan and run a cropping season on any phone. Anee, its smart farm technician, answers in Tagalog, Bisaya, Ilocano, Taglish or English. It suits crop farms from one lot to a full team, and it starts free.

blocks.text: Farmers ask us two things before they sign up. What does anee.io really do, and is it good for a farm like mine? This anee.io review answers both, with what it costs and where it falls short. Because we wrote it about our own app, it carries no star ratings, scores or quotes.
Key points

items: anee.io runs a cropping season from the first plan to the profit report: 50 tools in eight steps, on any phone.
Standouts: Anee, Anee Auto, a calendar that counts days, pest and disease finders, satellite and typhoon tools, money reports, offline mode.
Libre is free. Libre plus Anee costs PHP 70 a month, Solo Farmer PHP 200 and Farm Owner PHP 600.
It is built for crop farms in the Philippines. It is not for livestock, and it is not a marketplace.

blocks.text: What is the anee.io app?

The anee.io app is a mobile friendly web app for running a cropping season. It works in the browser of any phone, tablet or computer, and you can install it to your home screen. Its name comes from ani, the Filipino word for harvest, as our page on the [ani meaning](/blog/ani-meaning) explains.

Inside, 50 tools follow the season in eight steps, from the first plan to the reports. The eighth step, Anee Auto, is for farmers who want Anee to run it all. Every tool is on the [features page](/features).
Who built anee.io, and why?

It started as the system our own agronomists and technicians use on client farms. They built it as a cropping schedule manager, where tasks count from day zero and every peso goes on record.

We opened it to every farmer because small farms share the same problems. The average cost of producing palay in 2024 was PHP 59,695 per hectare. Economists say Filipino rice farmers must cut their cost per kilo by 30 percent to match Vietnam and Thailand. And pests take up to 40 percent of global crop production each year. So the app is built around timing, records and catching problems early.
Which anee.io features stand out?
Anee, the smart farm technician

Anee answers in Tagalog, Bisaya, Ilocano, Taglish or English. Before she answers, she reads your lots, their stage, your protocol and the weather. She can also look at a photo of a sick plant. Her answers use credits. Meet [Anee, the smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician).
Anee Auto

If you would rather not plan, Anee Auto asks about your lots, crop, soil, water, fertilizer and workers once. Then Anee writes every task from land preparation to harvest and keeps the plan on track. If a task cannot happen today, she moves it to the best day near it. Anee Auto uses credits.
A cropping calendar that counts days

The [cropping calendar](/features/cropping-calendar) dates every task from each lot's own day zero, so lots sown a week apart keep their own timing. The app knows the growth stages of 85 Philippine crops. Each lot shows what to do now and what to watch for, and Count the days shows how far apart two dates are.
The finders and NPK Plus

The field helpers come with Libre plus Anee and the plans above it, and so does the [NPK Plus calculator](/features/npk-plus-calculator). The Pest Finder, Disease Finder and Weed Control Helper name the likely problem and the active ingredients that control it, by group, never by brand. NPK Plus adds up the nutrients in your fertilizer plan. See the [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders).
Satellite and typhoon tools

With [Satellite Analysis](/features/satellite-analysis), Anee reads Sentinel 2 pictures of your field, plus Sentinel 1 radar that sees through typhoon clouds. It uses credits. [Satellite Weather](/features/satellite-weather) plays back the clouds and rain over your farm. It also shows every typhoon with its path, its cone and its distance from your field.
Workers, stock and money

Add each worker once in Global Workers and tick who came. The shed counts its own stock as tasks get done, and Cash to prepare shows what a day will cost. At season end, the labor, expenses and profit reports add up from those records. See the [farm reports](/features/farm-reports).
Offline mode and the morning email

Offline mode is always on, on every plan. Your changes wait on the phone and sync when the signal returns. Each morning at 6 AM, the day's plan also goes to the team by email, so everyone starts on the same page.
What is anee.io pricing, plan by plan?
All prices are in Philippine pesos. You pay from any bank or wallet app, and the full list is on the [pricing page](/pricing).

blocks.text: Is anee.io good for a small farm, and who is it best for?
The app fits best where the work follows a crop calendar and money goes out in many small amounts.

items: **Rice, corn and vegetable farmers** who want every fertilizer and spray on its right day.
**Family farms with hired help** who pay daily wages. Solo Farmer fits them.
**Owners who live away from the farm**, with a foreman on site. Farm Owner adds worker logins, and our guide to [managing a farm remotely](/blog/manage-a-farm-remotely) shows how.
**Farmers who would rather not plan**, who can hand the season to Anee Auto.

blocks.text: It is the wrong fit for livestock records or tax bookkeeping. It also does not sell inputs or buy harvests.
What should you know before you sign up?

items: **Anee needs internet.** The board, notes and records work offline, but her answers wait for a signal.
**Anee uses credits.** Solo Farmer comes with 30 each renewal and Farm Owner with 100, and you can buy more.
**Libre shows a few ads and holds one active season** with one lot. Libre plus Anee keeps those limits and the ads.
**Workers and inventory start at Solo Farmer.** Worker logins and the Collab Room start at Farm Owner.

blocks.text: How do you try anee.io on your own farm?

items.title: Sign up free and add one lot
items.text: Give the lot its crop, variety, size and planting day. Every task you add then counts from that day.

items.title: Tick the work for two weeks
items.text: Mark tasks done, add photos and note who worked. Then check that the board matches the field.

items.title: Decide what you need next
items.text: Add Anee with Libre plus Anee, or move to Solo Farmer for workers and every report. If Libre does the job, stay on it.

blocks.text: Questions about this anee.io review

items.q: Is this an independent anee.io review?
items.a: No. The anee.io team wrote it about our own app, and we say so at the top. It has no ratings, scores or customer quotes. To judge the app yourself, use the free Libre plan on one lot for a season.
Yes, the Libre plan is free, with a few ads. It covers one active season with the activities board, notes, growth stages and the labor report. Anee starts at Libre plus Anee, for PHP 70 a month.

items.q: Does the anee.io app need internet?
items.a: Not for the daily records. Offline mode is on for every plan, and your changes sync when the signal returns. Anee, the weather and the community still need a connection.

Anee answers in Tagalog, Bisaya, Ilocano, Taglish or English. Ask in the language you farm in, and send a photo if words are not enough. Our guide to the [Tagalog farm app](/blog/tagalog-farm-app) shows how.
It knows the growth stages of 85 Philippine crops, from palay and mais to gulay and fruit trees, annual and perennial. Each lot can grow a different crop. It does not keep livestock records.
